S.B.-D. 3408
R. Gen.

24. 3. 32.

March 24, 32.

Dear Mr. Bos,

With reference to your letter of March 31,
I send you herewith a detective report on the subject
of Mrs. Margaret Florine van Driest née Whyte
I shall be thankful if you will regard this report
as being secret and confidential.

Yours sincerely,
J.W.S.

H. Bos, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

* Encl. 1.
24/III.32. N.P.

1932年3月24日。

尊敬的博斯先生：

关于您3月31日的来信，现随函附上一份关于玛格丽特·弗洛琳·范·德里斯特夫人（Mrs. Margaret Florine van Driest，娘家姓怀特 Whyte）的侦探报告。
如蒙您将此报告视为秘密及机密文件，本人将不胜感激。

此致

J.W.S.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
REGISTRY
Section D. 3418 Station.
23 3 32.
Date March 23, 1932.

Subject (in full) Attached letter ref Mrs. Margaret Florine van Driest née Munot.

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by [Signature]

Regarding the attached letter from the Netherlands
Consulate-General concerning the above named Netherlands subject
by marriage, the following has been ascertained.
Mrs. van Driest arrived in Shanghai from Singapore via
Hongkong and Manila on February 15, 1932 as a passenger aboard
the Norddeutscher Lloyd s.s. "Trier". So far as can be learned she
arrived here unaccompanied. She put up at the Cathay Hotel on
the day of her arrival and occupied Room 405. The same evening
a French subject who gave his name as Paul Prunier and stated
he was 2nd Purser on s.s. "Trier" attempted to stay with her in
Room 405, but was forbidden to do so by the hotel management.
He eventually passed the night in the hotel, occupying Room 503,
but demurred at paying the bill presented to him, insisting that
he had been there at the invitation of Mrs. van Driest. The
management of the Cathay Hotel had a further occasion to warn
Mrs. van Driest that her conduct would not be tolerated on their
premises. This was due to the frequency of visits made to her
room by a foreign male whose nationality is not known. Mrs. van
Driest was also frequently seen in the company of a Eurasian girl.
On February 24 she left the Cathay Hotel and gave as her
forwarding address :- Box 660 c/o Phillips, Hongkong. There are
at present two letters at the Cathay Hotel addressed to Mrs. van
Driest. These bear the Singapore postmark and are dated
February 25 and March 5 respectively.
She left Shanghai for Hongkong on board s.s. "Tjibadak"
on February 25, the passage being booked through the Norddeutscher
Lloyd office.
When entering Shanghai, the subject of this report gave
the following particulars about herself :-

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

档案号
登记处
D科。3418分站。
1932年3月23日。
日期：1932年3月23日。

主题（全称）：附信，涉及玛格丽特·弗洛琳·范·德里斯特夫人（娘家姓穆诺 Munot）。

由特别巡捕摩尔（D.S. Moore）撰写。经由 [签名] 转呈

关于上述通过婚姻取得荷兰国籍之荷兰臣民，荷兰总领事馆来函提及此人，经查证情况如下。
范·德里斯特夫人于1932年2月15日作为乘客，乘坐北德意志劳埃德公司（Norddeutscher Lloyd）的“特里尔”号（s.s. "Trier"）轮船，经新加坡、香港和马尼拉抵达上海。据所知，她抵达时无人陪同。抵达当日，她入住华懋饭店（Cathay Hotel），占用405号房间。当晚，一名自称保罗·普吕尼耶（Paul Prunier）的法国籍男子声称自己是“特里尔”号的二副，试图进入405号房间与她同住，但被饭店管理层禁止。他最终在饭店过夜，占用503号房间，但拒绝支付向他出示的账单，坚称他是应范·德里斯特夫人的邀请而来。华懋饭店管理层曾再次警告范·德里斯特夫人，其行为在饭店内不被容忍。这是因为一名国籍不明的外国男性频繁探访她的房间。范·德里斯特夫人也经常被看到与一名欧亚混血女孩在一起。
2月24日，她离开华懋饭店，留下的转寄地址为：香港菲利普斯公司（Phillips）转660号信箱。目前华懋饭店有两封寄给范·德里斯特夫人的信件。这些信件盖有新加坡邮戳，日期分别为2月25日和3月5日。
她于2月25日乘坐“芝巴达”号（s.s. "Tjibadak"）轮船离开上海前往香港，船票是通过北德意志劳埃德公司办事处预订的。
在进入上海时，本报告涉及对象提供了以下个人信息：

REPORT
-2-
Station,
Date....................19
Subject (in full)....................................................................................................
Made by........................................Forwarded by....................................................
Age:- 29 years
Nationality:- Dutch
Place of Birth:- Mahone Bay, Canada.
Home address:- Mahone Bay, G.P.O. Box 118.
Passport:- No.16656 issued by Netherlands Consul-General
at Singapore March 17, 1930 and vised by the
Chinese Consul-General at Singapore January 6,
1932.
Friends:- Mr. Larin, Queen Ann Hotel, Hongkong.
In connection with the last item in the foregoing it
is interesting to note that one Fritz Larin, a former Russian
citizen of Latvian nationality is alleged to be a notorious
communist and counterfeiter and is known to the S.M.P. and the
Hongkong Police as an associate of Russian crooks and other bad
characters and also as a smuggler of narcotics. He was convicted
by the old Mixed Court in July 1923 for possession of morphia and
sentenced to 4 months imprisonment. Larin is in possession of
Passport No.8 issued by the Public Safety Bureau, Canton on
November 9, 1931 and vised by the Chinese Consul-General,
Singapore on January 25, 1932. He was in Shanghai from Feb.6 to
February 12, 1932, when he stayed at the Plaza Hotel and arrived
again in this city from Amoy on March 21, 1932.
W.B. Moore
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

年龄：29岁
国籍：荷兰
出生地：加拿大马洪湾（Mahone Bay）。
家庭住址：马洪湾，邮政信箱118号。
护照：第16656号，由荷兰驻新加坡总领事于1930年3月17日签发，并于1932年1月6日由中国驻新加坡总领事签证。
友人：拉林先生（Mr. Larin），香港皇后酒店（Queen Ann Hotel）。
关于前述最后一项，值得注意的是，据称一名名为弗里茨·拉林（Fritz Larin）的前俄罗斯公民（拉脱维亚国籍）是臭名昭著的共产主义者和伪造货币者，上海公共租界工部局警务处和香港警方均知悉其与俄罗斯罪犯及其他不良分子有交往，且从事毒品走私。他于1923年7月因持有吗啡被老混合法庭定罪，判处监禁4个月。拉林持有第8号护照，由广州公安局于1931年11月9日签发，并于1932年1月25日由中国驻新加坡总领事签证。他于1932年2月6日至2月12日期间在上海，入住百老汇大厦（Plaza Hotel），并于1932年3月21日再次从厦门抵达本市。
W.B. 摩尔
特别巡捕
特别部门主管。
（批注：X 归档 276）

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 3408.
Date 21. 3. 32.

No. 863.
SHANGHAI, 21 March 1932.

Sir,

I have the honour to request you kindly to fur-
nish me, if possible, with some information regarding
Mrs. Margaret Florine van Driest née Whynot, a Nether-
land subject by marriage, who is holding a Netherlands
passport No. 18856, issued by the Consul-General at
Singapore on March 17th 1930.

Mrs. van Driest is said to have arrived in Shanghai
with an English man, who since died here. Mrs. van
Driest was known in Shanghai as "Peggy".

She left for Hong Kong per s/s "Tjibadak" on Feb-
ruary 25th last and her conduct during the voyage and
in Hongkong was such that she made the impression of
being a woman of light morals. Thanking you in anti-
cipation,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名）
Chinese Secretary.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 S. B. D. 3408.
日期 1932年3月21日。

第863号。
上海，1932年3月21日。

先生：

本人荣幸地请求阁下尽可能提供有关玛格丽特·弗洛琳·范·德里斯特夫人（娘家姓怀诺特 Whynot）的一些信息，她是通过婚姻取得荷兰国籍的荷兰臣民，持有1930年3月17日由驻新加坡总领事签发的荷兰护照第18856号。

据说范·德里斯特夫人与一名英国男子一同抵达上海，该男子此后在上海去世。范·德里斯特夫人在上海被称为“佩吉”（Peggy）。

她于上月25日乘坐“芝巴达”号轮船前往香港，其在航行期间及在香港的行为举止给人留下了道德轻浮的印象。预先致谢，

本人荣幸地成为，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

（签名）
中文秘书。

（左侧手写批注：）
*

上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
